name: kharna_bgm_fest
caption: Festive joyful Chhath Puja instrumental, Bhojpuri folk celebration at a river ghat, bright uplifting and auspicious. Lively dholak and nagada rhythm, shehnai and bansuri lead melody, bright harmonium, jhanjh and manjira, temple bells, festive claps, folk Chhath geet feel, energetic but devotional, rising festive energy, no vocals, no singing, no chant, instrumental only.
